title: The Child Who Found a Dinosaur
short_teaser: Many important fossil discoveries have begun with ordinary people noticing an unusual shape in rock.
story: Many important fossil discoveries have begun with ordinary people noticing an unusual shape in rock. A curious child, farmer, or hiker can become the first person to see a clue preserved for millions of years. Expertise matters, but discovery often starts with the willingness to stop and look again. Discovery grows when we notice what does not fit, stay with the question, and resist the urge to explain it away too quickly. The lasting value is not merely knowing the fact. It is seeing the pattern beneath it and considering where that same pattern may already be present in ordinary life, creative work, or business.
impact: Expertise matters, but discovery often starts with the willingness to stop and look again. Discovery grows when we notice what does not fit, stay with the question, and resist the urge to explain it away too quickly.
spark_application: Write down one unexpected result or unanswered question from your own work. List three explanations before choosing one. Save a short note about what you noticed, what surprised you, or what you may want to revisit.
